Just thought I’d post a quick review for fellow Farangs in Thailand who care about health and wellness.

I first went to Boston Health for low testosterone issues. At 63, my levels were more like an 85-year-old’s, mostly from life stress. TRT made a big difference in energy and mood, but I was still struggling with sleep.

I’m big on fitness and prefer natural approaches, so when I learnt about the peptide “CJC-1295,” it made sense — it’s naturally found in the body and helps boost your own growth hormone. After two cycles, my sleep has improved (confirmed by my fitness watch), and I’ve lost some visceral fat too.

What stands out about Boston Health for me is their honesty and genuine interest in helping. They listen, don’t push things you don’t need, and actually explain what’s best for you. Their new peptide site makes picking the right peptide easy, with quality options and great support.

Highly recommend for anyone looking for safe, effective, and natural wellness solutions in Thailand.

— Tom

I have been coming to Boston Clinic for a year for TCM (Traditional Chinese Medicine) treatments with Dr Neon, so I was pleasantly surprised when in searching Chiang Mai for possible peptide treatments that Peptides Thailand was located within Boston Clinic.

Dr Ploy was very thorough in explaining an initial plan for me, and even helped me modify the peptide cycle a bit for my schedule, which was a little disconnected for a traditional peptide cycle. She was also very firm about not getting too complicated, as it was my first treatment. I have a number a chronic injuries. Instead of throwing an arsenal of peptides and a much higher price tag at me, she kept me in a reasonable systemic cycle for this first treatment.

The attention and care in this clinic is very thorough, thoughtful, and kind, and they will continue to be my number one choice for both Eastern and Western-style treatments.
